name: configure_selected_object_motion_part

stack.evidence: func_001D1D70 consumes three values, doubles the first two frame values, and queues object operation type 31 with the third value in its payload header

notes: The embedded operation-name table labels type 31 MOTION_PART. After a two-update delay, its dispatcher stores the three values in the selected object's motion-part fields at offsets 0x288, 0x28C, and 0x290 and enables motion flag 0x40. The motion update path remaps playback beyond segment_end_frame to segment_start_frame plus the overrun. The JP corpus contains 73 calls.
